question: The Election Commission of India was established in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1950**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Election Commission of India **was established in **1950**.
 
• **The Election Commission of India (ECI) **is a **constitutional body **established by the **Constitution of India **with the **mandate to oversee and regulate elections **throughout the country.
 
• **Article 324** of the Constitution empowers the Election Commission with the authority and responsibility for the superintendence, direction, and control of elections to various offices, including parliament, state legislatures, the presidency, and the vice presidency.
 
• As such, the Election Commission functions as a nationwide entity, serving **both the Central government and the state governments**.
 
• This esteemed body administers elections for a multitude of governmental positions, including the Lok Sabha, Rajya Sabha, State Legislative Assemblies, State Legislative Councils, as well as the offices of the President and Vice President of the nation.
 
• The Election Commission operates within the framework provided by the Constitution, as stipulated in Article 324, and implements relevant electoral laws such as the Representation of the People Act.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Established in 1950, the Election Commission initially comprised only** one Chief Election Commissioner.**
 
• However, on **October 16, 1989, ahead of the 1989 General Election,** two additional Commissioners were appointed, albeit for a brief period until January 1, 1990.
 
• Subsequently, the** Election Commissioner Amendment Act, 1989,** was enacted, transforming the commission into a multi-member body. Since then, a three-member Commission has been operational, with decisions made through majority voting.
 
• Situated in New Delhi, the commission is supported by its secretariat. Assisting the Election Commissioners are Deputy Election Commissioners, typically comprising Indian Administrative Service officers.
 
• **Rajiv Kumar**, a former Indian Administrative Service officer born on February 19, 1960, assumed office as the 25th Chief Election Commissioner of India on May 15, 2022, succeeding Sushil Chandra.
